translator_notes: Traditional. The note says the start seems to be missing. 'зашто Турчин да ќердоса' is my reading: 'rather than let a Turk have his way / enjoy (me)'; 'ќердоса' is a guess.

lines.cyr: Ми ја качил, мори, у кочија
lines.lat: Mi ja kačil, mori, u kočija
lines.en: He put her, hey, into a carriage,

lines.cyr: - Кочиџија, море, брат да си ми,
lines.lat: - Kočidžija, more, brat da si mi,

lines.cyr: брат да си ми, море, и побратим,
lines.lat: brat da si mi, more, i pobratim,
lines.en: be my brother, hey, and sworn brother,
so that I may wash, hey, my white face.

lines.cyr: Не ми изми, Сирма бело лице,
lines.lat: Ne mi izmi, Sirma belo lice,
lines.en: Don't wash your white face, Sirma,

lines.cyr: тук' се фрли, Сирма, во Дунава.
lines.lat: tuk' se frli, Sirma, vo Dunava.
lines.en: just throw yourself, Sirma, into the Danube.
rather than that a Turk should have his pleasure.
